title: Loading a glTF Model (Damaged Helmet)
description: Loads the classic Khronos 'Damaged Helmet' glTF 2.0 PBR asset from a self-contained binary .glb (geometry, metallic-roughness materials, and textures all embedded), creates a SceneModel, drives GLTFLoader directly, and frames the camera. Rendered with RealisticRender + sRGB tonemap to show the PBR shading as authored.
